scenario.name: traces
scenario.description: The traces consumer: spans schema, spans retention and metric rules.

schema.name: TraceRecord

fields.name: uuid
fields.doc: Unique identifier for the span record.

fields.name: trace_id
fields.doc: Identifier for the trace this span belongs to.

fields.name: span_id
fields.doc: Identifier for this span within the trace.

fields.name: parent_span_id
fields.doc: Identifier for the parent span, if any.

fields.name: trace_state
fields.doc: W3C trace state string.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Operation name of the span.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: SpanKind: 0=UNSPECIFIED, 1=INTERNAL, 2=SERVER, 3=CLIENT, 4=PRODUCER, 5=CONSUMER.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Trace flags as defined in W3C Trace Context specification.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.doc: Start time of the span, in microseconds since epoch.

fields.name: end_time
fields.doc: End time of the span, in microseconds since epoch.

fields.name: observed_timestamp
fields.doc: The timestamp when the span was received by the collector.

fields.name: service_name
fields.doc: The name of the service that generated the span.

fields.name: resource_attributes
fields.doc: Attributes describing the resource that produced the span.

fields.name: instrumentation_scope
fields.doc: The name and version of the instrumentation library that captured the span.

fields.name: attributes
fields.doc: A map of custom string-valued attributes associated with the span.

fields.name: dropped_attributes_count
fields.doc: Number of attributes that were dropped due to limits.

fields.name: events
fields.doc: Array of span events, each serialized as a JSON string.

fields.name: dropped_events_count
fields.doc: Number of events that were dropped due to limits.

fields.name: links
fields.doc: Array of span links, each serialized as a JSON string.

fields.name: dropped_links_count
fields.doc: Number of links that were dropped due to limits.

fields.name: status_code
fields.doc: Status code: 0=UNSET, 1=OK, 2=ERROR.

fields.name: status_message
fields.doc: Status message

fields.name: bytes_uncompressed
fields.doc: Logical content size of the row (sum of byte lengths of string/map/array fields). Used by drop-rule accounting; does not include fixed-width numeric or timestamp fields.

fields.name: retention_days
fields.doc: Per-row retention in days, stamped by the Node consumer from team retention rules. Null when unset — ClickHouse then falls back to the batch `retention-days` header. capture-logs always writes null; it does not evaluate team rules.
